description: This file defines the 'ConnectionLimitStrategy' interface within the Eclipse Hono project, which specifies methods for calculating and describing connection limits based on resources.

classes.name: ConnectionLimitStrategy
classes.description: An interface that defines a strategy for calculating recommended connection limits based on available resources and providing resource descriptions.

methods.name: getRecommendedLimit
methods.description: Returns the calculated connection limit recommendation based on the available resources.

methods.name: getResourcesDescription
methods.description: Provides a descriptive text of the resources and their amounts that the calculation considered; intended for logging.
